LESSON: DANGEROUS CHEMICALS AT HOME

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Safety Education
Topic 4.4: Dangerous chemicals at home

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Dangerous chemicals at home. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. mention the dangers caused by chemicals used at home,
2. embrace the need to avoid handling dangerous chemicals used at home to ensure safety. caused by dangerous chemicals used at home. colour some of the dangerous chemicals at home using pencils, colours, crayons and computing devices.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Dangerous chemicals at home.
2. Explain Dangerous chemicals at home to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Dangerous chemicals at home.
4. Show that you can: mention the dangers caused by chemicals used at home,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Dangerous chemicals at home. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Dangerous chemicals at home important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. mention the dangers caused by chemicals used at home,
2. embrace the need to avoid handling dangerous chemicals used at home to ensure safety. caused by dangerous chemicals used at home. colour some of the dangerous chemicals at home using pencils, colours, crayons and computing devices.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
